override.cancelBookingHint: Ho hlakoloa ho bontša hore peeletso le khomishene ea eona e hlakotsoe, 'me ho khutlisetsa mong'a motho eo e leng mong'a eona, 'me seahi se etsa hore se etelle pele hape.

detail.timelineTitle: Kemiso ea Nako ea Audit (ngoliso ena)
detail.disputeOpen: Ho na le khang ea ho ba le thepa ho moreki enoa - molekane e mong o re ke ea hae. Ho etsoa qeto leqepheng la Likhohlano.

cancellation.title: Pehelo e hlakotsoe
cancellation.hint: Booking le khomishene ea eona li hlakotsoe; mong'a ts'ebetso o khutletse ho molekane 'me sehahi se ka kopa tataiso ena hape.

disputes.title: Likhohlano tsa Beng
disputes.hint: Molekane eo ngoliso ea hae e ileng ea hanoa e le kopi a ka hanyetsa hore na moreki ke mang. Hlahloba mahlakore ka bobeli 'me u etse qeto.
disputes.empty: Ha ho likhang mabapi le boemo bona.
